description.narrative: Oxfam is a global organization that fights inequality to end poverty and injustice. Oxfam offers lifesaving support in times of crisis and advocate for economic justice, gender equality, and climate action. We demand equal rights and equal treatment so that everyone can thrive, not just survive. Oxfam in Laos is working towards a future where Laos people especially women and youth are empowered to hold government and others with power to account so that they can build a resilient society free from poverty and injustice. To make this vision a reality, Oxfam focuses on working with others to find lasting solutions to the injustice of poverty. Oxfam believes that this goal can only be achieved when Civil Society, communities, the State, private sector, media, and all other stakeholders work together to drive change. In this Supporting Informal Waste Workers project, Oxfam Role will be overall project management, technical guidance, donor reporting, financial oversight, and coordination with all stakeholders. Oxfam in Laos will work closely with Oxfam Novib and Oxfam Denmark to 1). Lead on partnership agreements and monitoring, 2). Provide technical input on gender, socialprotection, and inclusive market systems, and 3). Serve as the focal point for Carlsberg/LBC coordination and visibility.

participating-org.narrative:
Oxfam has had a presence in Lao PDR for longer than most INGOs, with both Oxfam in Belgium (OBE) and Oxfam Australia (OAU) beginning programming and establishing offices in the late 1980s. Oxfam’s vision is of a Laos in which all citizens – particularlywomen, the marginalised and discriminated groups – are able to claim their right to access opportunities and resources so as to overcome all forms of poverty and injustice.
Since 2015, the work of Oxfam in the country is governed by the Oxfam Country Strategy (2015-2019).We seek transformative changes in policies, practices and beliefs in ways that fundamentally improve the lives of poor and marginalised women and men, and ensure that all citizens have the same opportunities to enjoy their rights. Todo so, Oxfam focuses its work on four Domains of Change: Citizen Participation and Civil Society Development, Gender Justice, Resilient Communities and Sustainable Development, and Responsible Investment.
For this project, Oxfam in Laos will support theexpansion of the influencing work and public campaign on advocating for more inclusive social protection and access to social protection of the most marginalized workers. National public events will be organised, such Eliminate Violence Against Women Day(EVAW), and digital platforms will be used to socialize the information, and stir discussion and dialogue among rights holders, government stakeholders and policy makers. The campaigns will be implemented nationwide and in the provinces where Oxfam in Laosworks. Target groups include marginalized workers, youth, women, CSOs as well as government stakeholders.
